label: General web search
scope: Language region and product-domain web queries

label: GitHub repository search
scope: Public repository names descriptions topics and READMEs
decision_basis: Thirty-one broad batches still produce high first-seen yield and no three qualifying comparable runs

label: npm package registry
scope: Public npm package metadata and distributions

label: Product Hunt launch directory
